title: [RFC] Governance Process Upgrade: Establishing a Statute of Limitations for Temperature Checks
body_preview:
Author: @Eren_Targ5 (Daoplomats)

## Summary
This proposal seeks to establish a formal "Statute of Limitations" for Uniswap Governance proposals. Specifically, it mandates that any proposal which passes a "Temperature Check" (Snapshot vote) must proceed to an on-chain vote within 90 days.

body_preview:
# Summary
We are seeking to gauge community support for the proposed plan to deprecate Compound V2.

# Motivation
- V2 usage has materially declined as activity has shifted to V3 (the primary deployment for ~3 years).
- V2’s pooled-collateral model and long-tail markets increase systemic and governance risk compared to V3.
- A staged wind-down reduces complexity and attack surfaces.
